title: •••Rebel Scout
caption: •••Rebel Scout (V)
game_text: May deploy -1 as a ‘react’ to same site as a Rebel. When deployed, may peek at the top card of a Reserve Deck; may place that card on bottom of that Reserve Deck.
lore: A Rebel scout such as Vidar Blin is usually assigned to recon missions. Trained in first-response tactics, many come to the Alliance with prior special forces experience.
